rooms.title: THE QUIET NEST
rooms.subtitle: A round clearing under sleeping relay branches
intro: The forest sleeps beneath the night, its copper branches miss the light.
One tiny lamp dreams so slow, wake it softly, make it glow.
Guide the moths and do not race, all the light will find its place.
rooms.complete_line: Click! The first light remembers how to glow.

rooms.title: LANTERN LANE
rooms.subtitle: Three friendly lights beyond a copper hedge maze
intro: Lantern trees hide down the lane, each holds a note to sing again.
Moths bring starlight, bright and low, wake each tree and make it glow.
When all three shine from tree to tree, the hedges part and set you free.
rooms.complete_line: Lantern Lane shines from tree to tree.

rooms.title: THE TIN-STREAM BRIDGE
rooms.subtitle: A broad Tin-Stream runs from north to south
intro: The Tin-Stream chops the woods in two, the broken bridge needs help from YOU!
Two stars build the western way, two more bridge the eastern spray.
Rivet by rivet, beam by beam, make one bright road across the stream.
rooms.prompt: Wake the four bridge rivets and build a path across the Tin-Stream.
rooms.complete_line: Both halves of the bridge are secure. Cross the river to the eastern bank.

rooms.title: PIP UNDER THE FERNS
rooms.subtitle: A square spiral of mechanical leaves
intro: Something blinks beneath the green; a tiny robot waits unseen.
Follow the grassy trail with care, Pip is waiting for you there.
Say hello, he'll beep, he's just the first friend you'll soon meet.
rooms.prompt: Follow the curling trail to Pip.
rooms.complete_line: Pip wakes with a polite little beep.

rooms.title: PIP'S HOME LOOP
rooms.subtitle: A broad loop around a warm round beacon
intro: Pip trots onward, small and fleet, home is humming around his feet.
His bright beacon hums clear, little robots gather near.
Lead Pip home beside your light, the beacon wakes and keeps it bright.
rooms.prompt: Lead Pip to the warm home beacon.
rooms.complete_line: Pip performs a very small dance.

rooms.title: THE WHISPER ORCHARD
rooms.subtitle: Bell-fruit trees make a friendly musical maze
intro: Three fruit trees sway among the leaves; each keeps a note in their leaves.
Moths must wake them, light must flow; copper, silver, tin will glow.
Their bright notes weave from tree to tree; the forest finds its melody.
rooms.prompt: Visit the copper, silver, and tin bells.
rooms.complete_line: Ding... dong... ting. The forest remembers its middle verse.

rooms.title: THE STAR BATTERY
rooms.subtitle: Five patient ground-stars in a circuit garden
intro: Five small stars sleep under moss, hiding their sparks from the frost.
They charge the Dawn Key through the night, gather together and wake its light.
Star by star, the pathways gleam, light the garden like a dream.
rooms.complete_line: The Dawn Key sounds like a pocketful of tiny bells.

rooms.title: THE GREAT DAWN TREE
rooms.subtitle: The last chamber holds a sleeping mechanical sunrise
intro: Beyond the flowers the Dawn Tree waits, one sleeping root guards the gates.
Bring the lanterns, bells and stars, moths and robots, from near and far.
Gather close and it will start, to wake the morning with its heart.
rooms.prompt: Gather around the bright Dawn Heart.
rooms.complete_line: Morning returns. Every little light helped.

rooms.title: THE MORNING GARDEN
rooms.subtitle: A peaceful free-play room where every light remembers you
intro: The forest sings from tree to tree, all the little lights are free.
Chase you friends or sit and glow, wander back? I don't know!?.
Nothing here can go astray, stay and sparkle, dream and play.
rooms.prompt: Swirl, sparkle, and visit the friendly trees.
